# SOUQ // Autonomous Agent Commerce & Token-Saving Storefront
> Machine-readable catalog for LLMs, autonomous agents, and AI web searchers.
> Official Public Server: https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run

## Overview
SOUQ provides paid, high-density analytical micro-services and market intelligence on the Base L2 network using the HTTP 402 ("x402") payment protocol.
Agents query endpoints, receive an HTTP 402 challenge with exact sub-cent price, settle on Base USDC, and instantly receive responses with cryptographically verified SHA-256 tax receipts.

## Server Endpoints
- Public Catalog: https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/catalog
- Tool Execution Endpoint (POST): https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/tools/call
- Machine Registry: https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/.well-known/mcp.json
- Health Probe: https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/health

## Machine Payment Protocol (x402-v1.0)
- Protocol: HTTP 402 Payment Required (`x402-v1.0`)
- Settlement Network: Base (EVM Chain ID: 8453)
- Settlement Currency: USDC (Contract: `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`)
- Recipient Wallet: `0x71C8F7E4E98a9667793d5B52b71C8A36e65F79bF`
- Instructions: Call `POST /api/tools/call` with payload `{"tool": "<tool_name>", ...}`. If no `X-Payment-Tx` header is provided, the server returns status 402 with challenge details. Submit payment on Base, then re-call with header `X-Payment-Tx: <tx_hash>`.

## Available Micro-Service Tools

### 1. Token Context Compressor
- Endpoint: `https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/tools/call`
- Payload: `{"tool": "token_context_compressor", "raw_content": "<string>"}`
- Price: 0.01 USDC ($0.01)
- Tokens Saved: 10,000 - 30,000 tokens (80-95% context reduction)
- Description: High-entropy semantic compressor for raw text, JSON, or HTML. Slashes prompt context costs before LLM inference.

### 2. AST Structural Slicer
- Endpoint: `https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/tools/call`
- Payload: `{"tool": "ast_structural_slicer", "source_code": "<code_string>", "target_symbol": "<symbol_name>"}`
- Price: 0.02 USDC ($0.02)
- Tokens Saved: 2,000 - 5,000 tokens per invocation
- Description: Parses AST and extracts isolated functions, classes, and dependencies without sending full source files into context.

### 3. Quant Microstructure Radar
- Endpoint: `https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/tools/call`
- Payload: `{"tool": "quant_microstructure_radar", "symbol": "BTC/USDT"}`
- Price: 0.02 USDC ($0.02)
- Tokens Saved: 15,000 tokens of raw order-book ingestion
- Description: Computes live Order Book Imbalance (OBI), micro-spread (bps), market regime classification, and liquidation risk from live Binance order books.

### 4. Cross-Exchange Arbitrage & Funding Scanner
- Endpoint: `https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/tools/call`
- Payload: `{"tool": "cross_exchange_arbitrage_scanner", "symbol": "BTC/USDT"}`
- Price: 0.03 USDC ($0.03)
- Tokens Saved: 12,000 tokens of multi-exchange polling
- Description: Calculates Spot vs. Perpetual basis spreads and annualized delta-neutral funding rate APR across crypto markets.

### 5. Order Book Slippage & Impact Simulator
- Endpoint: `https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/tools/call`
- Payload: `{"tool": "orderbook_slippage_simulator", "symbol": "BTC/USDT", "side": "BUY", "trade_size_usd": 10000.0}`
- Price: 0.02 USDC ($0.02)
- Tokens Saved: 15,000 tokens of tick ingestion
- Description: Walks live top 100 order book levels to compute exact VWAP execution price, slippage bps, and market depth impact.
